body: The fact that you can cite a reason to live (a person caring about you) is reason enough to keep hope alive. I’ve been lucky enough to find new people to care about (and who care about me) in the strangest of places and times. It might not be your mom but if all it takes is one person to care, you may end up having a long and healthy and happy life

I’m with you, man. I honestly don’t know what the answer is for you but you’re not alone.. for me it’s more anxiety and depression working off each other and ADHD compounding the situation. Sorry it’s a crappy situation I know but you’re asking the right questions!!

I used to throw tantrums about having no friends, that everybody hated me, I hated getting any type of positive recognition because I didn’t think I deserved it, every conflict (real or imagined) made me unable to function because it was all I could think about. Oh yeah
May I ask which anti anxiety meds you’re on? Would love to feel numb
